name: (1S,2R)-nortilidine
summary: Nortilidine is the major active metabolite of tilidine. It is formed from tilidine by demethylation in the liver. The racemate has opioid analgesic effects roughly equivalent in potency to that of morphine. The (1R,2S)-isomer has NMDA antagonist activity. The drug also acts as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

pharmacology.text: Nortilidine is the major active metabolite of tilidine. The (1R,2S)-isomer has NMDA antagonist activity. The drug also acts as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Nortilidine has been sold as a designer drug, first being identified in Poland in May 2020.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing and kill. They also cause dependence, with a hard withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。這類藥物也會造成依賴，戒斷過程辛苦。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。这类药物也会造成依赖，戒断过程辛苦。

fact.en: Its parent drug tilidine is a painkiller widely prescribed in Germany, usually mixed with naloxone in the same tablet to discourage misuse. The liver turns tilidine into nortilidine, which does most of the work.
fact.zh: 它的母體藥物替利定（tilidine）是德國廣泛使用的處方止痛藥，通常在同一錠劑中加入納洛酮以防濫用。肝臟會把替利定轉化為主要發揮作用的去甲替利定。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体药物替利定（tilidine）是德国广泛使用的处方止痛药，通常在同一锭剂中加入纳洛酮以防滥用。肝脏会把替利定转化为主要发挥作用的去甲替利定。
